reserved_regions.use: Comparator outputs, CMP_CLK and the SEQ_SAMPLE tree on their own 0.3 um tracks with VSS shields between the signals. It crosses the two TOP drops only at right angles.
TOP tee. DM1EXCL-DM9EXCL and ODBLK/POBLK 1 um around the TOP centrelines; no other net runs parallel inside. Mirrored about the comparator axis.
TOP stubs into the comparator inputs and the prefill-qualified comparator core.
TOPN drop to XBOOTN.VOUT.
TOPP drop to XBOOTP.VOUT.

Local comparator decoupling, about 0.2355 pF; the pair meets the Stage 1 45 mV droop limit behind the in-core straps (24 mV modelled). NMOS only, so no N-well sits near the input pair. VDD from the top M2 pin; VSS from the P+ ring sides above y 71.5 so no strap crosses a TOP stub.
Mirror image of comparator_decap_west.

Bulk comparator and Bootstrap decoupling (up to about 1.5594 pF less the trunk) and the analog VDD/VSS trunk from the north edge, between the two VIN trunks. No digital routing. With analog_decap_west and analog_decap_east about 9.3 pF, the Stage 1 requirement of 9 pF.
Analog VDD/VSS decoupling west of Bootstrap N, about 5.57 pF, fed from the analog trunk along the north edge clear of the VINN drop (x 33.3).
Analog VDD/VSS decoupling east of Bootstrap P, about 2.19 pF, mirroring analog_decap_west's role for the P channel.
Unassigned decoupling reserve, about 12.7 pF, for the branch that Stage 2 or Stage 6 shows short, first the Bootstrap upper bound. No planned route crosses it.

CODE0-7/PRESET from the XREF east ports, CODE0 on the eastmost track. The comparator group turns south on shielded verticals and reorders to the frozen SAR pin order here. D0-D7/SAMPLE via stacks sit at via_stack_x_um. SAR supply straps.

Reference network beside the west ends of the pair M5 global rails (core y VREFP 16.725, VREFN 17.155): a 15 ohm series resistor per rail between the boundary pins and the rail ends, and part of the 8 pF between VREFP and VREFN. Extended north to y 75.2 so the capacitor and the two resistors fit. No capacitor from VREFN to VSS.
Reference decoupling, continued. With vref_decap_west about 8.6 pF of area for the Stage 1 requirement of 8 pF (+-25%) between VREFP and VREFN and the two series resistors.

XREF gate-driver VDD/VSS decoupling, about 2.9239 pF, on the pair feed from the south-edge boundary pins to the M6 terminals on the XREF strip. With xref_decap_east and pair_decap_southeast about 10.1 pF, the Stage 1 requirement of 10 pF.
Pair VDD/VSS decoupling continued east of xref_decap, about 3.40 pF, below the digital corridor and the CODE bus (y >= 11.2).
Pair VDD/VSS decoupling, about 3.75 pF, joined from xref_decap_east below it, east of the digital corridor. No pair metal crosses the CDAC array keep-out (power_plan.pair_supply).
SAR VDD/VSS feed and decoupling, about 7.08 pF; with sar_decap_north about 8.25 pF, the Stage 1 requirement of 8 pF. The macro DCAP fillers add margin.
SAR VDD/VSS decoupling north of the guard ring, about 1.17 pF. The strip east of the macro stays clear for the D0-D7/SAMPLE outputs.
1 um P+ substrate ring around the digital macro with its own VSS strap to the boundary. Corridor M3 stubs and the via stacks pass over it.
No top-level routing, power grid or fill on any layer over the array: its planned fill cell and DM1EXCL-DM9EXCL own it, and floating or fixed metal above it shifts bit weights.
No top-level routing on M4 and above except the accepted CMP_CLK drop on the axis.

power_plan.status: Decoupling sized on 2026-11-21 by the Stage 1 reference/supply budget (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#15) for the Stage 6 package model: two bonds per reference rail on interleaved VREFP/VREFN/VREFP/VREFN pads (1 nH + 0.1 ohm per rail), one 2 nH + 0.2 ohm bond per VDD/VSS pin, stiff off-chip sources with 100 nF at the pins. The core meets the budget on its own, without IO-ring decoupling; blocks, outline and planned signal routes are unchanged. Stage 2 and Stage 6 confirm it.
power_plan.decap_basis: Thin-oxide MOS capacitance including contacts and straps; replace with the PDK decap characterization.
power_plan.budget: Layout/results/rail_budget.md and Layout/specs/constraints.json (electrical_budgets, stage6_supply_model). Per-branch requirement for a 45 mV VDD-VSS droop at the block pins, with the largest measured 1 ns event times 1.3: pair 10 pF, SAR 8 pF, analog 9 pF, comparator local 0.47 pF.
power_plan.reference: VREFP/VREFN enter on the west edge, two boundary pins each, interleaved like their double-bonded pads (external_edges.south_west); the two pins of a rail join inside vref_decap_west ahead of its resistor, with one VREFP/VREFN crossing on the pad side. Each rail passes a 15 ohm series resistor (+-20%) to the west ends of the pair M5 reference rails, and 8 pF (+-25%) sits between VREFP and VREFN there, in vref_decap_west/vref_decap_south (about 8.6 pF of area). Without the series resistors the bond inductance and the decap ring at each CDAC update (2.7-7.3 LSB at the next decision with single 2 nH bonds); with them and the double bonds, 0.028 LSB at FF cold over the whole tolerance box. No capacitor from VREFN to VSS: at 0 V an NMOS gate on VREFN does not invert. Keep the substrate coupling of the reference capacitor to VSS small. Reference bulk at the pads makes the decision error worse.
power_plan.pair_supply: XREF/CDAC VDD/VSS enter at the pair's own M6 terminals on the XREF strip, VSS (45.215, 13.365) and VDD (46.915, 14.565) um, fed from the south-edge boundary pins ADC.VDD!@pair/ADC.0@pair (x 44/48) north through xref_decap; VDD and VSS swap sides on the way, so they cross once on different layers. The decoupling continues east along the south strip through xref_decap_east, below the digital corridor, to pair_decap_southeast. Nothing enters the CDAC array keep-out: extending the pair M5 global rails east would put about 35 um of metal inside it (chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#18). xref_decap, xref_decap_east and pair_decap_southeast hold about 10.1 pF. The largest measured XREF event is about 0.48 pC (255 toggled units); 40 mV droop modelled with a 12 ohm feed.
power_plan.analog: Comparator and Bootstrap VDD/VSS from the north edge (ADC.VDD!@north/ADC.0@north) through analog_decap_slot, plus the mirrored comparator strips and analog_decap_west/east beside the Bootstrap cells, about 9.3 pF in total. Each comparison draws about 25 fC with 0.3-0.4 mA peaks; the Bootstrap event is bounded by 0.454 pC per 1 ns, not measured. 40 mV droop modelled with a 12 ohm feed.
power_plan.digital: SAR macro M6 stripes, fed at ADC.VDD!@sar/ADC.0@sar on the east edge above SAMPLE into sar_decap_north; DCAP fillers inside the macro, sar_supply_and_decap below it and sar_decap_north above the guard ring, about 8.25 pF without the fillers; P+ guard ring around it. 28 mV droop modelled with a 5 ohm feed.
power_plan.spare: spare_decap_northeast (about 12.7 pF) is held free of routes for whichever branch Stage 2 or Stage 6 shows short.
power_plan.io_ring: Applied in io_ring.json: one AVDD/AVSS pad pair per branch (analog, reference pair, SAR) with about 100 pF of bulk and about 2 ohm ESR on its route, 13-92 um from the core (budget: at most 6 ohm feed); no reference bulk at the pads (30-335 pF there raises the decision error to 0.15-0.96 LSB undamped); VREFP and VREFN on two pads each, interleaved VREFP, VREFN, VREFP, VREFN, which takes a 7 x 7 ring (640 um).
power_plan.join: The analog, reference/pair and digital branches meet only at the ADC VDD!/0 boundary pins, so digital return current never flows through analog straps.
power_plan.grid: Top-level VDD/VSS on M8/M9 outside the CDAC array, the TOP fill exclusions, the comparator and the Bootstrap VIN trunks.
power_plan.density: The whole core fits inside one 125 um M8/M9 density window. The CDAC array keep-out and the TOP fill exclusions take 25% of such a window, so the rest of it, including area outside the core, must carry the density.

external_edges.north: VINN/VINP straight onto the two Bootstrap VIN pins (M5, 9.93 um each, mirrored); the analog VDD/VSS trunk enters between them at ADC.VDD!@north/ADC.0@north (x 44.115/48.115) through analog_decap_slot.
external_edges.east: D0-D7 out and SAMPLE in on M7 across the SAR macro; SAR VDD/VSS at ADC.VDD!@sar/ADC.0@sar (y 74/71) above SAMPLE, into sar_decap_north.
external_edges.south_west: VREFP/VREFN on four west-edge pins interleaved like their pads (ADC.VREFP@a/b at y 67/55, ADC.VREFN@a/b at y 61/49) into the reference network; pair VDD/VSS at ADC.VDD!@pair/ADC.0@pair on the south edge (x 44/48), below the pair's M6 terminals on the XREF strip.
external_edges.die_and_io: Layout/design/io_ring.json: 7 x 7 ring, 640 x 640 um outline, core origin at die (243.885, 329). Not applied to OA.

reasoning: The XREF + CDAC pair anchors the plan. The comparator sits on the CDAC TOP exits, flanked by the two Bootstrap cells so TOPN and TOPP see mirrored branches. The Bootstrap cells are lifted 2.7 um above the comparator to leave a channel for its outputs, CMP_CLK and the SEQ_SAMPLE tree. The comparator pins fix the channel order (OUTP lowest, CMP_CLK, OUTN), so nothing crosses near the comparator. The frozen SAR pin order (SEQ_SAMPLE, COMP_N, COMP_P, CMP_CLK from south to north) then forces five crossings, placed in the corridor; a balance stub gives OUTP the CMP_CLK crossing that OUTN cannot avoid. The CODE bus runs CODE0 on the eastmost corridor track and has no crossings. D0-D7 and SAMPLE cross the SAR macro to the east edge.
reserve: Unallocated space belongs to routing, supplies, isolation, guard rings and decoupling; it is not a routed utilization measurement. Decoupling regions are sized at the planning density in power_plan.

cmp_clk_north_drop.decision: CMP_CLK lands on the top end of the comparator M3 CLK trunk from the north, on an M4 drop along the mirror axis that runs 1.155 um over the core between the OUTP/OUTN trunks. This is an exception to the core note that keeps M4 and above clear.
cmp_clk_north_drop.basis: The TOP tee fills the 1.64 um between the comparator and the CDAC, so a south entry would run along or across the TOPP tee. On the axis the drop couples equally to both outputs and both inputs; the OUTP riser stub matches its exposure above the core.
cmp_clk_north_drop.verify: Top-level extraction: CLK coupling to OUTP/OUTN and to VINP/VINN stays mirror-matched to the v8 core level (largest mirror difference 0.0074 fF), and the comparator TT decision screen still passes with the extracted environment.

open_items: Confirm the accepted CMP_CLK north drop with top-level extraction (decisions.cmp_clk_north_drop.verify).

The TOP crossings are not mirrored: the TOPP drop is crossed by COMP_P, CMP_CLK, COMP_N and twice by SEQ_SAMPLE, the TOPN drop once by SEQ_SAMPLE. Estimated <= 0.05 fF static imbalance against the 1 fF limit and about 0.001 LSB of comparison-time coupling per crossing, which acts as offset; confirm in top-level PEX.

Decoupling follows the Stage 1 budget (power_plan, chenzc24/sar-adc-t28#15). Confirm the Bootstrap branch event and the per-branch charge with Stage 2, and the decap device, density and leakage with the PDK decap characterization.
Equalize COMP_P/COMP_N and the SEQ_SAMPLE arms on extracted capacitance once routed; the plan matches centreline length, shielding and crossings.

Feed the new boundary pins inside the core (io_ring.json): join the two pins of each reference rail in vref_decap_west ahead of its 15 ohm resistor (one VREFP/VREFN crossing on the pad side); bring the pair feed from ADC.VDD!@pair/ADC.0@pair north through xref_decap to the pair's M6 terminals, outside the CDAC keep-out; connect sar_decap_north to sar_supply_and_decap for the SAR feed.
